codes.use_case: Relatives don't help, or block each other
codes.moment: When a sibling caregiver stops sending mail and spending receipts
codes.want: Sibling to cooperate and share bills and receipts
codes.quote: Paul refuses to send me any of his past mail (which would include any outstanding bills), or any of his spending receipts

codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: When unknown bills and unagreed spending pile up
codes.want: Know every bill and keep spending to an agreed budget
codes.quote: I pay all of the bills online (that I am aware of)

codes.use_case: Being far away and not knowing what is happening
codes.moment: While handling the parent's affairs from hours away
codes.want: Know what is going on in the parent's home
codes.quote: I live a few hours away from him

codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: After the person holding legal authority took the parent's money and home
codes.want: Someone official to investigate and get justice
codes.quote: She took everything from him even his home.

codes.use_case: Relatives don't help, or block each other
codes.moment: When the person with legal authority gives no help with care
codes.quote: She has not been to one doctors appointment. I take care of all of that. I am the sole caregiver. I get no help.

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: While fighting alone for months to find any help
codes.want: Help to get through each day
codes.quote: The mental and emotional damage to myself is immense.

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: Every week when driving the parent to errands and appointments
codes.want: Freedom to travel and not feel trapped
codes.quote: I am very resentful of the 4 hours a week that I run her around or when other appointments come up.

codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: After home care services were denied because of income
codes.want: Affordable paid help for the parent at home
codes.quote: I had convinced her to accept an assessment for home care services who denied her based on her income.

codes.moment: When a move to assisted living is raised
codes.want: Parent to accept help beyond the caregiver
codes.quote: She is very resistant to assisted living that we can’t afford anyway

codes.use_case: Being far away and not knowing what is happening
codes.moment: While handling the parent's affairs from out of state
codes.want: Complete information from people near the parent
codes.quote: Basically everything is in disarray due to the distance and communication problems and lack of communication from people close to her.

codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: When an inherited retirement account causes trouble with Medicaid
codes.want: This paperwork nightmare to come to an end
codes.quote: currently I now have an IRA problem that was left to her as a beneficiary

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: After months of sorting out the parent's paperwork alone
codes.want: A break from being the one in charge
codes.quote: I need a break as it’s affecting my physical and mental health.

codes.use_case: Getting into the parent's accounts (bank, insurance, phone, portals, passwords)
codes.moment: When dealing with the parent's bank from a distance
codes.quote: bank problems and my mother refusing to go to the bank

codes.use_case: Choosing and arranging a place for them
codes.moment: After a hospital stay when no rehab place will accept her
codes.want: A rehab or care place that will take her
codes.quote: So far I haven't even found a nursing home with physical therapy options that will accept her having medicare, all are refusing her.

codes.use_case: Getting answers from doctors and hospitals
codes.moment: While the parent is in the hospital before discharge
codes.want: A straight answer from the hospital
codes.quote: I can't get the hospital to tell me a straight answer.

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: During the parent's sudden hospital stay
codes.want: Someone to ask and cover for own appointments
codes.quote: I am sleep-deprived, have no one to ask, and am honestly in full despair.

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: After moving the parent into a nursing home
codes.want: To stop feeling guilty about the placement
codes.quote: Regardless of these realities, I still feel guilty about placing her in a nursing home.

codes.use_case: Choosing and arranging a place for them
codes.moment: During a short hospital stay used to arrange placement
codes.quote: I used one of her short hospital stays to discharge her to a nursing home (a good one).

codes.moment: When the parent says she was tricked into the home
codes.quote: Sometimes she says I "tricked" her into being there.

codes.moment: When the facility avoids anxiety medicines seen as restraints
codes.want: The right medicine for the parent's anxiety
codes.quote: They have her on depakote. Not sure that’s the best thing but the nursing home worries about using medications that are considered “restraints”.

codes.use_case: Relatives don't help, or block each other
codes.moment: After a sibling with legal authority bans visits
codes.want: To visit the parent who wants to see them
codes.quote: told me one day not to come to see my mom anymore that she had POA

codes.use_case: Choosing and arranging a place for them
codes.moment: When the parent should no longer live alone
codes.want: A care home with company, good food and activities
codes.quote: I, along with his doctor, believe he should not be living alone and should be somewhere with social interaction, good food and stuff to do.

codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: While working out what care the parent can afford
codes.want: Know what the parent can afford and for how long
codes.quote: Who is the best person to help me with his financials and what I can do with them to provide a stream of income

codes.moment: Every day when the parent calls family dozens of times
codes.want: Calls to stop and the parent's anxiety to ease
codes.quote: my sister received 30 calls on Tuesday and by early afternoon yesterday had 15

codes.use_case: Relatives don't help, or block each other
codes.moment: When siblings disagree on taking away the parent's phone
codes.want: Siblings to agree on one decision
codes.quote: We have a family split 2 to 2 on removing the phone.

codes.moment: When the parent talks with eyes closed in the afternoon
codes.want: The parent to feel comfortable with little anxiety
codes.quote: My mom has entered a phase where she will “talk” to me with her eyes closed.

codes.moment: When the parent in a wheelchair keeps trying to stand and falls
codes.want: Keep the parent seated and stop the falls
codes.quote: My mom has recently become wheelchair bound and keeps attempting to stand or walk and falls.

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: After the parent's recent dementia diagnosis
codes.want: Advice on how to cope
codes.quote: This has really affected me not in a good way.

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: While working and looking for caregiver support
codes.want: An evening or weekend support group for adult children
codes.quote: I have been looking for a support group, but they are all during the day geared toward retired care gives.

codes.moment: When the husband withdraws and stops wanting to do things together
codes.want: To understand whether the change comes from the illness
codes.quote: Increasingly, he has no interest in doing anything together.

codes.moment: Every evening when the parent forgets the evening pills
codes.want: An alert when the evening pills are not taken
codes.quote: Looking for a pill box or dispenser that will sense if it's been picked up or opened or similar, and alert a caregiver if it has not.

codes.moment: When the parent living alone leaves the stove on
codes.want: Lower the worst safety risks while other plans fall into place
codes.quote: I installed wifi smart stove knobs on his stove because he was  occasionally leaving it on and burning pans.

codes.use_case: Money, legal papers and facility bills
codes.moment: When the parent orders products online and forgets doing it
codes.want: Limit charges and stop the scams
codes.quote: she often orders vitamins and other brain supplements—getting scammed—but doesn’t remember doing it

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: During heated daily conflicts with the parent
codes.want: Time for own family and stable mental health
codes.quote: I'm so angry that she's ruining my life and destroying my mental health that I've worked so hard to stabilize.

codes.moment: When early dementia makes the parent self-centered
codes.want: To stop being angry at the parent
codes.quote: She's still in fairly early stages of Alzheimer's so in some ways she's really still so much herself - but changing and so incredibly self-centered and frustrating.

codes.moment: During visits when the parent asks the same questions nonstop
codes.quote: His short term memory is gone. The repetitive questions are nearly non stop.

codes.use_case: Exhaustion, guilt and no life of their own
codes.moment: After hard visits, with no family or friends to lean on
codes.want: Someone to lean on
codes.quote: And no, I've got no family support or anyone to lean on except his other caregivers

codes.moment: When setting up the parent's weekly medicines
codes.quote: he will only take meds he's told are from the VA

codes.moment: Every day when fighting the partner to take many pills
codes.want: Fewer pills, focused on quality of life
codes.quote: fighting him about taking the 8-15 pills daily, I have started asking about quality of life rather than quantity

codes.use_case: Safety when they are alone or out
codes.moment: While the caregiver sleeps and the diabetic partner sneaks sweets
codes.quote: If I happen to fall asleep, hubby, a type 2 diabetic will sneak ice cream and anything sweet he can find.

codes.moment: When doctors order frequent visits that ignore their situation
codes.want: Doctors to factor in the whole situation
codes.quote: I feel like Primary Care and many other doctors only treat by looking at a sheet and giving everyone the same tests

codes.moment: When told to walk with the partner despite own injury
codes.quote: They want him to exercise, but I cannot go for walks with him due to my rollator and bad knee

codes.moment: When relying on food pantries for the household's food
codes.quote: We are on free food from local pantries, which results in a high number of carbs

codes.moment: When the partner refuses to change soiled pants
codes.quote: Dementia patient who doesn’t want to change soiled pants.

codes.moment: While the partner needs constant activity all day
codes.want: Ideas for keeping the partner occupied
codes.quote: She needs to be doing something all the time and expects me to provide her with something to do.

codes.moment: After daycare ends each afternoon and on weekends
codes.want: More relief than daycare gives
codes.quote: I couldn't survive without this help but it's not enough.

codes.moment: When weighing memory care against daycare and home care
codes.want: To know if memory care would be better for her
codes.quote: I'm wondering if she would be better off living at a memory care facility

codes.moment: When hospice workers first arrive at the home
codes.want: Hospice that gives the care that was promised
codes.quote: Hospice was a bust. We requested care for midday to afternoon visits and to have English-speaking caretakers.

codes.moment: When the partner will not wake up for daily care
codes.quote: she would not wake up for daily care

codes.moment: When planning to visit the partner in memory care
codes.want: To understand why visiting feels impossible
codes.quote: I cannot seem to force myself to visit with her, and I couldn’t, even to save my life, say why.

codes.moment: After the first facility left the partner in dirty clothes all day
codes.want: A facility that keeps up good care
codes.quote: When they started leaving her in her room all day in the same dirty clothes, I found another place as quickly as I could.

codes.use_case: Relatives and others not helping or criticizing
codes.moment: When a relative calls to criticize the partner's clothes in care
codes.want: Relatives to accept hygiene over appearance
codes.quote: She was upset that my DH did not have a polo shirt and jeans on.

codes.moment: Every day when the partner asks the same question repeatedly
codes.want: To know how to respond
codes.quote: How should I respond to the same question multiple times everyday.

codes.use_case: Safety when they are alone or out
codes.moment: When the partner goes out walking alone
codes.want: A reliable way to track where he is
codes.quote: My husband likes to walk so I need a tracking device

codes.moment: When a move away from the remote home is raised
codes.want: To agree on a plan together
codes.quote: But he does not want to leave.

codes.moment: While deciding whether to move, in poor health herself
codes.want: To be closer to doctors and services
codes.quote: I'm a little older and not in the best of health either.

codes.moment: After testing, while waiting for treatment approval
codes.quote: now it is just waiting for the review board and insurance to give the final approval

codes.moment: When planning to sell the home and buy another
codes.want: To avoid paying a fortune in loans
codes.quote: A big concern about all this is the coordination of selling and buying so that we aren't paying a fortune in loans.

codes.moment: After another family death brings back caregiving grief
codes.want: To know if it gets easier
codes.quote: I was finally feeling like there was life after dementia until my sister passed last week. The grief came flooding back.

codes.moment: When the partner tries to pick up patterns on surfaces
codes.want: To know if it is a concern
codes.quote: DH has been trying to pick up things that are only the pattern in either the floor, bedspread, or countertop.

codes.moment: When the partner keeps making questionable financial decisions
codes.want: To take over the finances safely
codes.quote: He has been making very questionable financial decisions.

codes.moment: After diagnosis when the partner insists he is fine
codes.want: Partner to hand over control of finances
codes.quote: He refuses to give up control to me.

codes.use_case: Relatives and others not helping or criticizing
codes.moment: When the partner's relatives degrade the caregiver
codes.want: Relatives to be supportive
codes.quote: the bigger problem for me is his daughter and exwife that have given me more grief than anyone else

codes.moment: While caregiving with severe anxiety and depression
codes.want: Someone to talk to without judgement
codes.quote: someone I can talk to without judgement and willing to work WITH me to help with my severe anxiety and depression

codes.use_case: Safety when they are alone or out
codes.moment: When the partner drives and slows at green lights
codes.want: Everyone, including the grandchild, to be safe
codes.quote: I’ve been noticing when he drives he’s slowing down at all intersections even if the light is green.

codes.moment: When it is time to tell family he should stop driving
codes.want: More time before the hard conversation
codes.quote: I'm so heartbroken that this might be a conversation we need to have quickly.

codes.moment: Every day when the partner says she wants to go home
codes.want: New ideas to calm her
codes.quote: My wife, who has Alzheimer’s, is constantly saying she wants to go home (we are living at home)

codes.moment: When correcting the partner's misuse of things at home
codes.want: To be able to communicate with her
codes.quote: Can't communicate at all.

codes.moment: During the in-home hospice evaluation and signing
codes.quote: It was more emotional than I thought it was going to be.

codes.moment: When the partner stops eating, drinking and walking well
codes.quote: My DH has been having difficulty walking, getting up and down and barely speaking much and not eating or drinking well.
